hint: Hover or tap a section of the profile.

parts.title: storage → S3 storage adapter
parts.body: Writes every work file, result file and output under s3://robin-outputs/prod.

parts.title: compute → SageMaker compute adapter
parts.body: Starts each task in its model family's image, on that model's instance type, with at most 20 running at once. The role comes from an environment variable.

parts.title: governance → none yet
parts.body: In the first pass SoundHub's IAM policies decide what the job role can read, and ROBIN keeps its own record.

parts.title: tasks → controller settings
parts.body: Not an adapter: how many recordings go into each task when a run is split up.

parts.title: resolver → soundhub-robin
parts.body: Names a module and function. At submit, the CLI imports it and calls build(settings) to get the SoundHub catalog adapter.

parts.title: prod.yaml → database
parts.body: The production environment replaces whole sections of config.yaml. Here: PostgreSQL on RDS, connecting with an IAM token made from the person's AWS login, so no password is stored.

parts.title: compose
parts.body: Runs once at startup. Merge prod.yaml over config.yaml, fill each ${NAME} from the environment (a missing one stops startup), check the combination makes sense, then build the adapters.
